name: io.github.tonyyang0504/aliexpress_ds-mcp
description: AliExpress Dropshipping (DS) API / AliExpress Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIEXPRESS_DS_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: App Key of your AliExpress Open Platform Dropshipping app (Console > App Management; https://openservice.aliexpress.com/doc/doc.htm#/?docId=1589).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIEXPRESS_DS_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call (uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the parameters sorted by name as name+value, docId=1386). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIEXPRESS_DS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Buyer (dropshipper) access_token from the authorization-code exchange /auth/token/create (docId=1592). Production tokens last 30 days (expires_in 2592000); renew with /auth/token/refresh (docId=1593) and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIEXPRESS_DS_SHIP_TO_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter destination country used for DS prices, stock and search (countryCode / ship_to_country), e.g. US.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIEXPRESS_DS_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency for search and product prices (currency / target_currency), e.g. USD.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIEXPRESS_DS_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Locale for search, product text and tracking (local / target_language / language), e.g. en_US.
